dataList.name: Rien, The Index Nursefather
dataList.desc: Terima -50% damage dari Serangan Tanpa Lawan Terima -50% damage dari [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], dan [Sinking] Ketika healing SP dari [UnlockBuff_Base], jika SP unit ini is di bawah 15, memulihkan SP hingga 15 Encounter Start: Peroleh [BurningWoundRien_Mask] dan memulihkan SP hingga 45 Pada 55%- HP, end the giliran dan peroleh a new pattern - Hilangkan semua effects other than those exclusive to unit ini - Change [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack to 0
dataList.flavor:
I waited for "the moment" as the Prescript told me to.
Even after my darling daughter left, I waited.

And after a while, I was contacted by Limbus Company, dan saw that the Backdoor was open.
That's when the device beeped dan let me know that it was finally time to bring my daughter home.

dataList.name: Oracle Device [Caduceus]
dataList.desc: A acak weapon is assigned to setiap Coin. Tiap senjata memiliki efek unik. - [RienWeapon01Hatchet] - [RienWeapon02Stiletto] - [RienWeapon03Greatsword] - [RienWeapon04Rapier] - [RienWeapon05Sledgehammer] - [RienWeapon06Ultragreatsword] - [RienWeapon07Lance] - [RienWeapon08Chain] - [RienWeapon09Scythe] Ketika menggunakan an Attack Skill, peroleh 1 [StackRienSpecialSkill] (maks 9) - Can be memperoleh sekali per Skill; does not peroleh Stack dari the same Skill dua kali Mulai Giliran: Pada 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack, gunakan a powerful Skill - Akhir Serangan: Setelah menggunakan the powerful Skill untuk pertama kalinya, peroleh [Shin_Rien] - Reset the per-Skill [StackRienSpecialSkill] cap - Min & Maks Speed +15 - Akhir Giliran: Peroleh 1 [Vulnerable] dan 2 [ResultReduction] giliran berikutnya Turn 4 Start after entering the field: Pada kurang dari 9 [StackRienSpecialSkill], bring its Stack to 9; lalu, peroleh (Stack memperoleh x 3) [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Then, aktifkan efek ini setiap 4 giliran
dataList.flavor:
A vial of what looks like liquid metal capable of changing its shape dan mass, its qualities almost like those of Singularities, swishes inside the Device.
The form the fluid menerima is contingent on the Prescript the Device receives. The weapons it produces depend on the information regarding target dan the time limit given to carry out the assassination.
One day, as he received a dagger too small for the task, he elected to wait hingga it produced a different weapon. However, despite the approaching deadline, it refused to provide him a proper weapon; he had no choice but to kill his target dengan a fork.

dataList.name: Will of the Prescript
dataList.desc: Mulai Giliran: - Peroleh [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] berdasarkan pada [UnlockBuff_Base] stage pada diri sendiri - Beri [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] terhadap a acak Pendosa, dan prioritize attacking them - Ketika menggunakan a Skill terhadap [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], ubah semua Coin on that Skill to [SuperCoin] Ketika menyerang, jika [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, atau jika unit ini can no longer attack that target, gunakan the remaining Skill terhadap a acak Pendosa - Memprioritaskan target dengan the lowest current HP, unless they have 1 HP - Ketika the secara acak chosen Pendosa is killed, atau jika the said Pendosa's HP is brought down ke 1, repeat efek ini on another Pendosa Beri +2.5% damage terhadap [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] untuk setiap [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (maks 20%) - Pada 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], beri +30% damage terhadap semua target
dataList.flavor:
Do you wish me to raise a family?

"It must've been fate that brought us together. To think that I'd ever meet a husband like you..."

dataList.name: Undertake Prescript
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Jika [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed giliran ini, memulihkan 10 SP dan peroleh 3 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (sekali per giliran) Akhir Giliran: Jika [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed giliran ini, peroleh 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien] - Jika unit ini tidak memiliki [UnlockBuff_Base], peroleh 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] pada Akhir Giliran - Pada 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], does not peroleh [KarmaOfIndexRien]
dataList.flavor:
Do you wish me to lose my family?

"Honey, I gotta terima a quick trip up north today."
"Ah, also—hey, buddy. I'm expecting a package this afternoon, so would you be a dear dan pick it up for me, sweetheart?"

dataList.name: Unlock
dataList.desc:
Akhir Giliran: Pada 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] atau at 95%-/85%-/75%- HP,- Peroleh [UnlockBuff_Rien1]/[UnlockBuff_Rien2]/[UnlockBuff_Rien3]

Turn 1 End after entering the field: Pada lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 1, peroleh [UnlockBuff_Rien1]
Turn 3 End after entering the field: Pada lower than [UnlockBuff_Base] stage 2, peroleh [UnlockBuff_Rien2]

Ketika [UnlockBuff_Base] is diaktifkan akibat HP atau Giliran conditionals:
- Pada kurang dari 3/6/9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] Stack, raise them to 3/6/9
Peroleh 5 [KarmaOfIndexRien] at the next Mulai Giliran untuk setiap Stack memperoleh
dataList.flavor: "Following the Prescripts is to unlock what is locked."

dataList.name: Fixed Panik
dataList.desc:
Beri the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Akhir Giliran: Jika unit ini is in Panik, raise SP to 15

dataList.name: Rien, the Father [Imitation]
dataList.desc: Terima -75% damage dari Serangan Tanpa Lawan Terima -75% damage dari [Combustion], [Laceration], [Vibration], [Burst], dan [Sinking] Ketika healing SP dari [UnlockBuff_Base], jika SP unit ini is di bawah 30, memulihkan hingga 30 SP Ketika unit ini enters a new phase at 55% HP, peroleh efek berikut: - Hilangkan semua effects other than those exclusive to unit ini - Reset [StackRienSpecialSkill] Stack to 0 - Peroleh [IndexPrescript_RienSecondPhase] - Ubah [BurningWoundRien_Mask] to [BurningWoundRien] - Ubah [KarmaOfIndexRien] to [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase]; lalu peroleh 10 Stack of that effect - Jika unit ini tidak memiliki [Shin_Rien], immediately peroleh that effect Pada 25% atau lower HP, peroleh a new pattern dan greatly enhance a Skill tertentu
dataList.flavor:
Once, he harbored a suspicion that he was being shaped menjadi an imitation of someone; he doubted the Will dan nearly defied it, for he did not know whom he was to mimic. Only when it was too late did he understand its intent dan come to accept the Prescript's will.
Only lalu was the false father completed.

dataList.flavor: An unparalleled weapon dan a curse bestowed by Hermes, a god of the City whose Prescripts are distributed by radio waves.

dataList.name: Will of the Prescript
dataList.desc: Mulai Giliran: - Beri [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] terhadap a acak Pendosa, dan prioritize attacking them - Ketika menggunakan a Skill terhadap [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality], ubah semua Coin on that Skill to [SuperCoin] - Peroleh [Protection] setara dengan [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (maks 9) - Kehilangan 1 Stack untuk setiap 20 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] Ketika menyerang, jika [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] is killed, atau jika unit ini can no longer attack that target, gunakan the remaining Skill terhadap a acak other Pendosa - Memprioritaskan target dengan the lowest current HP, unless they have 1 HP - Ketika the secara acak chosen Pendosa is killed, atau jika the said Pendosa's HP is brought down ke 1, repeat efek ini on another Pendosa Beri +5% damage terhadap [IndexPrescriptTargetToPersonality] untuk setiap [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (maks 40%) - Pada 9 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy], beri +50% damage terhadap semua target Starting dari the first giliran after the phase change, aktifkan efek berikut: - Mulai Giliran: Peroleh [BlackNightmare] · Jika unit ini used a powerful attack di giliran sebelumnya, lose [BlackNightmare] for that giliran
dataList.flavor:
I raised a family.

"You're not supposed to be here right now."
"My work is still much underway, dan I'd like to carve them up in peace so they can attain the most exquisite beauty I can sculpt."
"... Don't tell me, are you here to defy the Prescript?"

dataList.name: Undertake Prescript
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Jika [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was executed giliran ini, memulihkan 15 SP dan peroleh 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] (sekali per giliran) Akhir Giliran: Jika [IndexPrescript_Base_2nd] was not executed giliran ini, peroleh 8 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] dan kehilangan 1 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] - Jika unit ini used a powerful Skill giliran ini, peroleh 12 [KarmaOfIndexRien_2Phase] dan kehilangan 2 [BlessingOfIndexPrescriptEnemy] saja
dataList.flavor:
I... lost my family.

"Don't go..."
"Don't go... Not... like this... Daddy... Please... help us..."

dataList.desc:
Beri the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Akhir Giliran: Jika unit ini is in Panik, raise SP to 30

dataList.name: Fixed Panik
dataList.desc:
Beri the [PanicChangeLock] effect
Akhir Giliran: Jika unit ini is in Panik, raise SP to 45

dataList.name: Let's Play Tag! Here I Go!
dataList.desc: Mulai Giliran: Jika terdapat no [TagGameBuff]s, unit ini's 1/2/3 other kawan yang memiliki the lowest Level menjadi [TagGameBuff] for 3 giliran (number of unit receiving efek ini increases setiap kali efek ini activates) Jika [TagGameBuff] effect kadaluarsa while the unit that had the [TagGameBuff] effect is alive, peroleh efek berikut: - Semua Pendosa terima damage tetap setara dengan 40% HP each - Reduce SP to -45 for a acak Pendosa who can enter E.G.O Corrosion[TabExplain] atau Panik Jika a Pendosa kills a [TagGameBuff], the said Pendosa memperoleh 1 [ResultEnhancement] for the rest of this Pertarungan (efek ini can be memperoleh cumulatively)

dataList.name: Akankah Kau Bermain? Akankah Kau Bermain? Akankah Kau Bermain?
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Jika unit ini is the only surviving kawan, atau jika the Core berada pada 50%- HP, gunakan "Let's Play Together Forever~!" giliran berikutnya (sekali per Pertarungan)

dataList.name: No More Playtime
dataList.desc: Mulai Giliran: The "Stuffed Toy" Bagian memperoleh [Protection] setara dengan jumlah dari kawan mengecualikan unit ini Ketika "Stuffed Toy" Bagian telah dihancurkan, Akankah Kau Bermain? dan its remaining kawan are killed

dataList.name: Attachment Plushie
dataList.desc: HP damage diterima by the Core is fixed at 0

dataList.name: Semua of My Corpus memiliki been Given to Tibia
dataList.desc:
Terima -30% HP, SP damage dari [Combustion], [Vibration], [Burst], dan [Sinking]
Terima -50% damage dari [Laceration]

Mulai Giliran: Jika unit ini terkena Stagger, pulih dari Stagger. Afterward, peroleh 2 [CrimsonTakeDamageUp] dan becomes unable untuk menggunakan "Installation Art no. 3: Improvised Ribcage" hingga giliran berikutnya (sekali per Pertarungan)

Akhir Giliran: Peroleh 1 [DefenseDown] giliran berikutnya untuk setiap 4 [Combustion] pada diri sendiri (maks 15)

dataList.name: Observation
dataList.desc:
Pertarungan Start: Beri 1 [ObservedPerson] pada semua musuh; lalu, peroleh Potency [Breath] dan Count setara dengan jumlah dari unit with [ObservedPerson]

Mulai Giliran: Beri 1 [ObservedPerson] terhadap target without [ObservedPerson]

For setiap 10 [ObservedPerson] pada target, beri +1 lebih Potency [Vibration] dan Count with unit ini's Skill (maks 3)

dataList.name: Adaptasi
dataList.desc: Peroleh 1 Potency [Breath] setiap kali unit ini memberi damage with Attack Skill effects (15 per giliran) - Jika target memiliki 15+ [ObservedPerson], peroleh 1 tambahan Potency [Breath] with setiap hit Peroleh +1 Count [Breath] setiap kali unit ini menerima damage dari a Pendosa's Attack Skill effects (15 per giliran) - Jika target memiliki 15+ [ObservedPerson], peroleh +1 tambahan Count [Breath] with setiap hit taken Mulai Giliran: Beri 3 [ResultReduction] dan 5 [ObservedPerson] to the Pendosa who dealt the most damage ke unit ini di giliran sebelumnya - Jika target memiliki 30 [ObservedPerson], beri 5 [ResultReduction] saja

dataList.name: Defense Mechanism
dataList.desc: Mulai Giliran: Peroleh Perisai setara dengan 30% dari HP yang hilang (Perisai HP tidak bisa exceed 25% of the maks HP) - Jika unit ini memiliki [Combustion], lose ([Combustion] Count x 1.5)% Perisai HP - Perisai menerima +100% damage dari [Burst] effects Akhir Giliran: Jika the Perisai yang diperoleh dari efek ini telah dihancurkan, for the rest of this Pertarungan, peroleh 1 [DefenseDown] pada Mulai Giliran untuk setiap instance the Perisai memiliki been destroyed (maks 5)

dataList.name: Confirmation Bias
dataList.desc: Akhir Giliran: Siphon 10 SP dari para Pendosa (maks 3 para Pendosa in descending order of SP; does not beri cumulatively on the same target) (Tidak aktif jika Hohenheim is Panicked) This unit's SP does not turun di bawah 15

dataList.name: Establish Hypothesis
dataList.desc:
Pada Giliran 3: Peroleh pola baru dan prepares untuk menggunakan a powerful Skill.
Setelah Giliran 3 selesai: The above effect activates ketika unit ini memiliki 30+ Count [Breath] pada Akhir Giliran

Jika unit ini did not terima any HP damage during the preparation period before menggunakan the powerful Skill, greatly enhance the Skill (does not count damages taken by Perisai HP)

dataList.name: Maladaptasi
dataList.desc:
Ketika dilemahkan oleh Event Pilihan, Pasif ini menggantikan 「Adaptasi」

Peroleh 1 Potency [Breath] setiap kali unit ini memberi damage with Attack Skill effects (15 per giliran)
- Jika target memiliki 15+ [ObservedPerson], peroleh 1 tambahan Potency [Breath] with setiap hit; however, kurangi target's [ObservedPerson] by 3

Peroleh +1 Count [Breath] setiap kali unit ini menerima damage dari a Pendosa's Attack Skill effects (15 per giliran)
- Jika target memiliki 15+ [ObservedPerson], peroleh +1 tambahan Count [Breath] with setiap hit taken; however, kurangi target's [ObservedPerson] by 3

Critical damage does not increase atau decrease

dataList.name: Inadequate Defense Mechanism

Mulai Giliran: Peroleh Perisai setara dengan 15% dari HP yang hilang (Perisai HP tidak bisa exceed 5% of the maks HP)

- Perisai menerima +150% damage dari [Burst] effects

dataList.desc: Sesaat memasuki Pertarungan, unit ini memperoleh [TimeEntangleFour] Jika unit ini tidak memiliki [TimeGapAb], unit ini memperoleh [TimeGapAb] setara dengan ([TimeEntangleDesc] stage x 400) (sekali per [TimeEntangleDesc] stage) Pada stage 3 dan 4 [TimeEntangleDesc], jika unit ini loses semua [TimeGapAb], the pattern changes dan menjadi terkena Stagger for the giliran berikutnya Pada stage 2 [TimeEntangleDesc], jika unit ini loses semua [TimeGapAb], the pattern changes Terima -30% HP, SP damage dari [Combustion], [Laceration], [Burst], dan [Sinking]; -30% to Batas Stagger raised by [Vibration]
